products.name: Unit Placement Readiness
products.product: A focused portable restroom delivery placement readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: portable restroom rental and recurring sanitation service operators
products.problem: Drivers reach construction or event sites without an approved placement point, surface check, access route, onsite contact, service clearance, or pickup condition.
products.valueProposition: Turns portable restroom delivery placement readiness into a visible operating queue so every delivery is released with the correct units, approved placement evidence, safe access, onsite contact, and recurring-service clearance.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets portable toilet placement checklist, porta potty delivery software, portable restroom site plan, and sanitation unit delivery searches.

products.name: Route Service Exception
products.product: A focused portable restroom route service exception tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: portable restroom rental and recurring sanitation service operators
products.problem: A driver can mark a stop attempted while locked gates, moved units, blocked access, damage, overuse, or missing supplies require office, customer, or follow-up action.
products.valueProposition: Turns portable restroom route service exception tracking into a visible operating queue so every incomplete or abnormal unit service has unit-level evidence, customer impact, owner, billing treatment, and a verified recovery outcome.
products.topic: portable restroom route service exception tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size

products.seoAngle: Targets portable restroom service log, porta potty route exception, portable toilet proof of service, and sanitation route tracker searches.
